title: Zesty Portuguese Chicken Flatbread
description: A flaky, quick flatbread with Portuguese spices, grilled chicken, and a tangy citrus glaze, perfect for a high-protein lunch.
instructions: In a bowl mix flour, instant dry yeast, salt, and dashi powder until combined.
Add warm water and olive oil to the dry mixture, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise for 20 minutes until doubled.
Preheat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Divide the risen dough into 4 equal portions, rolling each into a thin round.
Cook each flatbread in the skillet for 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, sauté chicken, onion, garlic, and paprika in a separate pan until cooked through, about 7 minutes.
Spread the cooked mixture onto each flatbread, then top with lemon zest and cilantro.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for extra zing.
